quotes.text: D211808 removed prefs that disabled native Windows notifications and added handling for notification-windowsTag plus notification-windowsAction in MessengerContentHandler. The Windows alerts service is loaded lazily because its initialization does disk I/O; the guard also handles environments without nsIWindowsAlertsService. Current code still keeps that guard and has further handling for stale tags and startup survival while the asynchronous tag is processed. When changing native notification activation, check the command-line path as well as the alert UI and keep startup alive until the tag work finishes.
